implementationScope: package-only progressive JFIF 4:2:0 incremental session with semantic-unit marker streaming, exact-MCU transport, cadence-aware output/render lifetime and first-SOS quantization-source release

cases.mechanismPressure: single-byte scheduling observes a real 260-byte frame quantization-source high-water and proves it is absent after the first completed scan while every preview remains pixel-identical
large coefficient state proves raw DQT source slots do not remain hidden inside the persistent arena; final render still dominates operation peak
restart-heavy suspension verifies first-SOS quantization release composes with transactional MCU rollback and marker splitting

requiredInvariants: All v6 transport, marker streaming, source authority, output cadence, RenderArena and transactional-MCU invariants remain unchanged.

Pre-frame DQT/DHT state remains normalized to four quantization slots and eight Huffman slots; SOF2 transitions those authorities into separate lifetimes rather than retaining one combined table arena.
FrameQuantizationSourceState is exactly 260 bytes: four 64-byte raw 8-bit DQT slots plus four presence bytes. It can be redefined after SOF2 but only before the first SOS.

The first SOS expands the frame-selected source quantizers into three persistent 64-entry UInt16 dequantization tables, then releases FrameQuantizationSourceState before entropy suspension can persist.
DQT after the first SOS remains fail-closed, while a byte-identical DQT redefinition between SOF2 and the first SOS is accepted by both complete and incremental decoders.

Persistent fixed state after the first SOS is exactly 2776 bytes: 384 bound-quantization bytes + 192 progression bytes + 128 Huffman-count bytes + 2048 Huffman-symbol bytes + 16 Huffman-symbol-count bytes + 8 Huffman-presence bytes. No alignment tail is charged as semantic state.
SOF2 transition peak includes initial pre-frame state, the new persistent state and the 260-byte frame quantization source because those allocations coexist until pre-frame authority is released.

After the first SOS, retainedBetweenCalls excludes all raw quantization-source bytes. For every-preview cadence it is transport + persistent state + reusable RGB; for final-only it is transport + persistent state only.
The 23x13 source has persistentStateByteCount 4312, renderScratchByteCount 2752 and totalStateBytes 7064; after first-SOS latch final-only retained state would be 4726 bytes before any output.
The 576x576 source has persistentStateByteCount 998104 and renderScratchByteCount 17088; final-only pre-finish retained state is 998518 bytes and final render peak is 2010934 bytes.
The restart64 source has persistentStateByteCount 15064 and renderScratchByteCount 2752; final-only pre-finish retained state is 15478 bytes and operation peak is 30518 bytes.
Terminal finish/cancel/fatal failure still publishes zero codec-owned retained/operation/output state.
This profile does not qualify public DecodedImage color representation, non-JFIF semantics, embedded ICC, other sampling modes, physical RSS, allocator headers or perceptual reconstruction quality.
